senses.gloss: m. (pl. forms מָרֵא, מָרֵי, מָארֵי) (Arab. marua, cmp. מָרָא, to be strong; cmp. גָּבַר a. גֶּבֶר) man, lord, master; somebody; (as a title) Mar.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 2:15">Tosef. Shek. II, 15</cite> <he>מפני שמר על הכל</he> because he was ruler &c., v. <cite ref="A02068"><he>אֲמַרְכּוֹל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Horayot 13a:14">Hor. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר כולא</he> (prob. to be read <he>מרא כולא</he>).—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31:10">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>מָרִי נח</he> my lord Noah.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:13">Y. Peah VIII, end, 21ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יכעוס מָרִי עלי</he> let my lord not be angry &c.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 37:19">Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:2">Targ. Prov. XXIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:16">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מר רבה … ואי מר וכ׳</he> if the one (Moses) is teacher (leader), thou art a pupil (subordinate), and if the other (Korah) is &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 105a:3">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מר אמר חדא ומר אמר וכ׳</he> one said one thing, another another thing, but they do not differ.
<cite ref="Yoma 20b:6">Yoma 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ומר אמר לי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ואת אמרת</he>) and you, Sir, say to me &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 20b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מר ניהו רב נינח מר</he> (Rashi <he>מר הוא</he>) the man (you speak of) is a teacher; sit down, Sir.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:11">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מר אמר ליה לימא מר וכ׳</he> one said to him, tell us, Sir &c.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 2a:12">Ber. 2ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אמר מר</he> it has been said (introducing a discussion on a subject previously touched upon).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:7">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>אכן מָרָהּ דשמעתא וכ׳</he> in such a case the author of the rule would not have maintained it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:4">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ</cite> <he>הא מרי שמועתא והא מ׳ עובדא</he> here is a master of traditions and a master of practice.
Gen. R. s. 58 (expl. תושב, Gen. XXIII, 4) מארי ביתא (= בעל הבית) owner of a house, citizen, opp. דיירא.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32b:5">Succ. 32ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>שרי ליה מָרֵיה ל־</he> the Lord forgive him (he is mistaken).—
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:7">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>יעביד מָרָנָא עליה</he> let our lord do with this (be contented for the present).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:8">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> [read:] <he>אין את מָרָהּ דנפשך</he> (cmp.

<cite ref="Proverbs 23:2">Prov. XXIII, 2</cite>) if thou art master over thy desire; <he>אי נפשך מָרָתָךְ</he> if thy desire is master over thee; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:33">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>אנא מָרֵי דנפשי אנא</he> I am master over my desire; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M02650"><he>מָרֵי</he></cite> = <he>בַּעֲלִים</he> (used as sing. a. pl.; v. supra).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 3:12">Targ. Is. III, 12</cite>; a. fr.—<cite ref="M02579"><he>מָרָוָותָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02613"><he>מָרָוָתָא</he></cite> (pl. of <cite ref="M02613"><he>מָרוּתָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 5:13">Targ. Prov. V, 13</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M00639"><he>מוֹרָי</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Gittin 40a">Gitt. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>כלו מ׳ בתראי</he> the owners at second hand (of the settlement of slaves) died out; <he>אהדרו אבני מ׳ קדמאי</he> apply (for emancipation) to the heirs of the original owners.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3b:14">B. Bath. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>קטלינהו לכולהו מָרָוָתֵיה</he> (Var. <he>לכולהו בני מרותיה</he>) he (Herod) killed all of his master’s family.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 103a:2">B. Kam. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דכיתנא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מָרָוָותֵיה</he>) the owner of the flax; a. fr.—Mar Samuel, Mar Ukban &c., v. respect. pr. nouns.—Fem. <he>מָרְתָא</he>, <he>מָרְתָה</he>
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 17:17">Targ. I Kings XVII, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 24:2">Targ. Is. XXIV, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">Gen. R. s. 52</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01057"><he>בַּעֲלָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:5">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> <he>מ׳ דביתא</he> the hostess.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:7:8">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ</cite> top [read:] <he>הב ליה יתיר דנפשיה מָרָתֵיה</he> give him (the poor man) more, for his appetite is his master (he is used to good living). Y. Ab. Zar. l. c., v. supra; a. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 56a">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. <he>מ׳ בת ביתוס</he>, v. <cite ref="B00758"><he>בַּיְתוֹס</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Moed Katan 26b:24">M. Kat. 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אבא בר מ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="M02784"><he>מָרַת</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yevamot 120a:15">Yeb. 120ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 121b">Sabb. 121ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 84a">Yoma 84ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60); a. e.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5a:12">Snh. 5ᵃ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 52a">B. Bath. 52ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8).
<cite ref="Pesachim 103a:1">Pes. 103ᵃ</cite> top <he>מ׳ אמר</he> (Ms. M. 1 <he>רב ברונא</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>מרונא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
